name: octogen
description: Find, compare, and recommend products using Octogen search and product URL lookup.

interface.longDescription: Search Octogen's product catalog, look up a product by URL, and compare recommendations based on the product information returned. Connect your Octogen account to get started.
defaultPrompt: Find products that match what I am looking for.
Look up this product URL and explain its details.
Help me compare products and find suitable alternatives.
